title: The Speed Portal
description: Race endlessly through 4 3D tunnel distance zones (Warmup, Overclock, Hyperdrive, Singularity), dodging barriers and laser spokes while threading speed rings.

maker.name: Madi AI Creative Team
maker.bio: Building the future of autonomous revenue engines.

keyboard.Space: Tap to hop or hold to dive toward the center

instructions: Steer with A/D or Left/Right. Tap Space to hop over low barriers, hold it to dive toward the center, or ride cyan ramps to launch. Gravity returns you to the wall you steer toward. Dodge air mines and laser spokes, and thread emerald speed rings to boost and recharge your shield.
